name: Odai Dahi
title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Full stack developer who builds production apps in React, TypeScript and Next.js for very different users: an AI governance platform at Art25, analytics dashboards built for prospective clients such as Oatly, a sports-tech platform, a heritage railway federation whose audience is mostly 55+, and AI for retail. Was the sole frontend developer at Aeoflo with full ownership of a 20,000+ line codebase. Graduated from Hyper Island in March 2026 and has kept shipping since.

experience.meta: Stockholm · Pre-seed startup · AI governance and GRC platform
bullets: Develop features for a unified AI governance and GRC platform in Next.js, React and TypeScript on Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Realtime, row-level security), deployed on Vercel.
Lead UI development for configurable forms and contribute UI work across several core platform modules.
Fix and ship tested issues in a review-based workflow with the core team (feature → develop → test → production).
Set up agentic development on the codebase: AI agents that organize how AI works in the repo, and the security around that setup.
Designed the logo and build the website for NIARR (niarr.eu), the NGO founded by Art25.
experience.tech: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · shadcn/ui · Recharts · Supabase · Vercel
